annotation.title_clean: Yapay Zekâ ve Etik Sorunlar: İnsanlık, Teknolojinin Kontrolünü Kaybediyor Mu?
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence and Ethical Problems: Is Humanity Losing Control of Technology?
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli Üniversitesi İletişim Fakültesi (for TÜBİTAK Bilim Genç)
annotation.summary_en: Popular-science article in TÜBİTAK's Bilim Genç outlining AI ethical problems: privacy violations, misinformation, bias, the 'big data divide', media/NewsGPT distortions, manipulation by chatbots, and autonomous weapons. Calls for ethics-compliant algorithm design and basic ethical rules to avoid losing control of technology.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI raises privacy and data security risks through unauthorised data use
Responsibility for erroneous AI decisions remains unclear
Biased training data reproduces discrimination and creates a 'big data divide'
Autonomous weapons removing human control may cause war crimes and civilian casualties
Basic ethical rules and ethics-aligned algorithm design are needed
